resolved_config.calibration: Fixed scale 1/sigma, no human or condition-specific fitting. Not a Bayesian optimum. Disconnected scores use minimum-norm component centering; report rank deficiency.
resolved_config.equation: Fit centered item scores to all support q_t with unweighted least squares using ordinary item identities; minimum-norm np.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None). Query margin=(score_left-score_right)/sigma. No p,z,true d,rank,or query labels used for inference. Duplicate channels are not counted as independent observations. Exactly zero scalar observations are treated as blank and omitted, including evidence-removal interventions.
resolved_config.evaluation: Generic development/test and Liu clean/folded/noisy observations, plus fixed controlled history panel. Apply existing policy/core metrics; full/global identical by construction. Compare information integration sufficiency, not RNN necessity from a comparator failure. There is one comparator result per observation condition (not one new observer per training seed); bootstrap seed is the fixed development seed. History panel is identical across these comparator conditions.
resolved_config.name: least_squares
